headline: Brief v2.1.3-beta — Voice Memo Waveform & Speech-to-Text (All 4 LLMs), Live Web Search Website Logos + ▾ Sources Drawer & 4-Stage Claude Motion
bullets: Voice Memo Waveform & Speech-to-Text Across All 4 LLMs + PC Mic Selector: Tap the Microphone button right beside Send to turn your message bar into a live waveform memo and convert your voice into exact text on Gemini, OpenAI, Claude & OpenRouter; on PC & laptops, click the arrow inside the mic circle to switch inserted Headphones, 3.5mm Aux, USB, or built-in mics (hidden on phones & tablets).

Live Web Search Website Logos & Expandable ▾ Sources Drawer: Shows real website favicons on the right whenever Brief searches the web, expanding below to display what was searched, visited links, and a crisp blue Open button for every website.

4-Stage Claude #d9693f Motion (1.2× Faster) & Main-Menu Clawd: Starburst petals smoothly spawn 3 pure orbiting balls (1.2× faster, zero rings), align into soft wave pulse & jumping loading dots, and display Clawd strictly on the Brief Work main menu.

Fixed Model-Switch Status & Added Calm Redirect Memory: Eliminated stuck Checking… / Ready indicators when switching providers and upgraded multi-turn redirect memory ('No, open X instead of Y') across Windows, Linux & Android.
